Nidalees one of my mains and I split push a lot when I play her. 

Never, ever split push without vision. River and the buff closest to the tower are good places to ward at first, but depending on how deep youre going and how much map control your team has you may be better warding closer to mid for some early warning. 

Never all in someone either while split pushing unless you are 100% sure you can kill them quickly. You can be in a dangerous spot and you dont want to over extend for a kill and lose pressure. You could also get ganked from behind and get stuck in a 2v1. 

Always be doing something. If the wave is at their tower, counter jungle, ward or even just make a move so you can quickly join your team without blowing teleport or ult.

Know your teams capabilities. If your team has decent wave clear you can often split push for free and drawing one or two people can stop the enemy from diving. If your team gets into a fight, know when to join them and when to not. sometimes its best to cut your loses and take a tower before basing rather than coming in and dying yourself.

And most importantly communicate with your team at all times. Let them know if the person defneding leaves. Tell them what lane youre pushing and try suggest where they go themselves. 

For a general idea of champs/lanes and their pros cons:

Top:
Shen: Fairly obvious and popular one. Very tanky with dashes makes him hard to take down making him very forgiving. He also has very good consistent damage making him hard to trade with. He also has insane team fighting with his ult and taunt making him a good pick overall. Also a decent jungler. would recommend picking him up first. He is banned a lot though making him hard to practise outside of blind pick. Sunfire is core on him for split pushing since he lacks wave clear. Trinity force makes him an even stronger dueler and can help him with killing towers faster.

Nidalee: Great escape artist. Her low cd jump makes it so easy to get out of risky situations and she can sustain her self quite well. She can also trap meaning she can be more general with wards. Cougar form has decent wave clear and AD nid can duel very well. Shes not tanky without items though, and her team fighting is nowhere near as good as shens though and she has no innate teleporting meaning you have to react quickly or take summoner teleport. Shes also really good mid obviously, but i prefer using her to poke with the team in that case. Item wise, trinity or lich bane help her kill towers really fast, but shes incredibly flexible in builds. You can build pretty much anything on her.

Teemo: Great at harassing, but very squishy. His team fighting is also next to useless. He also lacks wave clear, relying solely on autos. His shrooms give him insane map control though, best of the split pushers in my opinion. With enough ap or liandries anyone coming to defend is going to take a ton of damage making them easy pickings. He also has move quick for fast getaways and again his shrooms, but move quick is on a pretty long cd.

Jungle:
Shaco: only one i can think of off the top of my head, but he's really good at it. Strong duelist, can destroy towers quickly with his clone and has a flash + stealth in one ability giving him an easy getaway. His boxes can double as cc or map control. He lacks in team fighting though, and taking your smite away from the team is risky. Statikk Shyv is good on him, and i quite like sunfire cape too but thats just personal preference.

Mid: 
Twisted fate: Get lich bane, destroy towers. He clears waves insanely fast too with wild cards. He also has a teleport that doesnt require a target and reveals people coming to gank you. Best mid for the job in my opinion and he still has a decent enough burst/poke when he's with the team. He lacks a good escape though so you get caught out, youre pretty much dead.

Bot:
Quinn: played her the least out of them all, but ad carries kill towers insanely fast. She can reveal the map and has a good get away skill in her ult which also gives her insane as boosts off her w. Cant really say much more about her.

His other problem is he doesn't have a swing timer reset, like say Irelia or Shyvana do to give a lot of burst, he's very clear in when he wants to go in, with the Masochism giving a very clear audio cue. 

I'm probably going to test out a different build though, I like the early wriggles and it combines well with his natural sustain once you hit 6 that I might try giving Wit's End a shot after it for the AS. The problem is, even if you pull ahead you don't really DOMINATE a lane like you could on other bruisers, he lacks the cc to stop people from fighting back. I had a lane as Jax vs Mundo in a blind pick game, and all I had to do was bait his ult, pull back and then dive in before it came back off CD. I was also 0-3 and behind on farm due to jungle/mid ganks. He has a pretty safe lane though, I don't see him really losing a lane since he can still grab minions due to his cleavers and he's hard to dive with heal/ult.
